objective: Non-Season2 Connect chat latest-message and spacious composer backport for guarded production source candidate, stacked only on Wall comment ad safety candidate.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main AA3AA7 at parent of PR #979; non-Season2 Wall candidate SHA 720ea2ab107e02f96cc28a87905750ae95d42c37. Exact code from merged staging #976; no live production release, no SQL or Season2 changes.
chosenApproach: Preserve chronological FlatList/history anchors. Composer focus temporarily follows latest through keyboard and layout reflows. Own-send wins over an in-flight older-history offset; manual scroll opts out. Reuse existing attachment sheet behind a single 44dp plus control and measure composer height for safe bottom clearance.
alternativeApproaches: Invert message list and rewrite pagination/read cursor logic (rejected: high regressions)
Keep two large attachment buttons and force scroll only on keyboard event (rejected: narrow input and missed Android layout shifts)
selectionRationale: Scope-limited UI and scroll behavior repair with existing backend, read cursor, ad lifecycle, reward systems and production runtime unchanged.
preserveBehaviors: Personal and scoped chat messages remain chronologically ordered and confidential
Older history offset, manual reading, read receipts and latest button work as before
Photo editing/upload, file selection, emoji/GIF/avatar picker and quick reaction remain reachable
No mutation to login, Supabase RLS, economy, ads, native runtime or production OTA
acceptanceChecks: On input focus, most recent message appears directly above composer as the keyboard opens
After send, optimistic latest message is visible and keyboard stays ready for next message
When manually swiping older messages, scroll is not stolen by reflow
At 360dp Android width, unified attachment control leaves more horizontal writing space
Composer expansion with multi-line input and photo/reply preview never obscures last row
Focused Node tests and CI required before staging integration; separate real-device smoke before release
No Season2 code, billing, runtime or production release marker changes; require source and AdMob/nav verification before OTA.
releaseTarget: non-Season2 DEV production RC source; no production OTA marker
